content: 1. Co-administration of drugs that are substrates of CYP3A4 with nevirapine may increase the risk of adverse effects due to altered metabolism. 2. Nevirapine reduces the plasma levels or therapeutic effects of fostamatinib by inducing hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 enzymes. Avoid or consider alternative drugs. 3. Nevirapine decreases the levels of ibrutinib by enhancing its metabolism through CYP3A4. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Strong CYP3A inducers can reduce ibrutinib plasma concentrations by approximately tenfold. 4. Nevirapine lowers the levels or effects of idelalisib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Strong CYP3A4 inducers significantly reduce systemic exposure to idelalisib. 5. Idelalisib increases the levels or effects of nevirapine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Idelalisib is a strong CYP3A inhibitor; avoid co-administration with sensitive CYP3A substrates. 6. Nevirapine reduces the levels or effects of irinotecan and irinotecan liposomal formulations by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 7. Itraconazole increases the levels or effects of nevirapine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 8. Nevirapine decreases the levels or effects of ivabradine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Avoid co-administration of ivabradine with moderate CYP3A4 inducers. 9. Nevirapine reduces the levels of ivacaftor by inducing CYP enzyme activity, while ivacaftor increases efavirenz levels by inhibiting CYP3A4. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 10. Nevirapine decreases the levels or effects of ivosidenib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Ivosidenib reduces nevirapine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4. Avoid co-administration with sensitive CYP3A4 substrates. 11. Nevirapine reduces the levels or effects of ixazomib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Strong CYP3A inducers decrease ixazomib Cmax by 54% and AUC by 74%. 12. Nevirapine decreases ketoconazole levels by increasing its metabolism, while ketoconazole increases nevirapine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 13. Lenacapavir reduces nevirapine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Co-administration of lenacapavir and nevirapine may result in therapeutic failure and resistance. 14. Levoketoconazole increases nevirapine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4, while nevirapine decreases levoketoconazole levels by increasing its metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 15. Nevirapine reduces the levels or effects of oral contraceptives containing levonorgestrel, ethinyl estradiol, and ferrous bisglycinate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use alternative or backup contraception for 28 days after discontinuing enzyme inducers. 16. Nevirapine increases the levels or effects of lonafarnib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. If co-administration is unavoidable, reduce lonafarnib to its starting dose and monitor for arrhythmias. 17. Lopinavir increases nevirapine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 18. Lorlatinib reduces nevirapine levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Co-administration increases the risk of severe hepatotoxicity. 19. Nevirapine decreases the levels or effects of lovastatin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 20. Discontinue antiretrovirals at least one month before mobilization and until all apheresis cycles are completed when using lovotibeglogene autotemcel. Long-acting antiretrovirals may require longer discontinuation periods. 21. Nevirapine reduces the levels or effects of macimorelin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Co-administration may lead to false-positive test results. 22. Nevirapine decreases the levels or effects of macitentan by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Avoid co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. 23. Nevirapine reduces mestranol levels by an unknown mechanism. This combination is contraindicated. 24. Nevirapine decreases the levels or effects of midostaurin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Strong CYP3A4 inducers may reduce midostaurin concentrations, leading to reduced efficacy. 25. Nevirapine reduces the levels or effects of naldemedine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Avoid co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. 26. Nefazodone increases nevirapine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 27. Nevirapine decreases the levels or effects of neratinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Avoid co-administration with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers. 28. Nevirapine reduces the levels or effects of netupitant/palonosetron by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 29. Nevirapine decreases the levels or effects of olaparib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Avoid co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. 30. Nevirapine reduces the levels or effects of osimertinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Avoid concomitant use with strong CYP3A inducers. 31. Nevirapine decreases the levels or effects of pacritinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 32. Nevirapine reduces the levels or effects of palbociclib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Strong CYP3A inducers decrease palbociclib plasma exposure by approximately 85%. 33. Nevirapine decreases the levels or effects of perampanel by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 34. Nevirapine and pexidartinib both increase the risk of hepatotoxicity. Avoid co-administration with other hepatotoxic agents. 35. Nevirapine reduces the levels or effects of pomalidomide by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 36. Nevirapine decreases the levels or effects of ponatinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid unless the benefits outweigh the risks of ponatinib underexposure. 37. Pretomanid regimens are associated with hepatotoxicity. Avoid alcohol and hepatotoxic agents, including herbal supplements and drugs other than bedaquiline and linezolid. 38. Nevirapine reduces the levels or effects of ranolazine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 39. Rifampin decreases nevirapine levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 40. Nevirapine reduces the levels or effects of rolapitant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 41. Nevirapine decreases the levels or effects of romidepsin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 42. Nevirapine reduces the levels or effects of silodosin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 43. Nevirapine decreases the levels or effects of simvastatin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 44. Nevirapine reduces the levels or effects of sirolimus by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 45. Nevirapine decreases the levels or effects of sofosbuvir/velpatasvir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 46. Nevirapine reduces the levels or effects of sonidegib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 47. St. John’s Wort decreases nevirapine levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 48. Nevirapine reduces the levels or effects of stiripentol by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. If co-administration is unavoidable, increase the stiripentol dose. 49. Nevirapine decreases the levels or effects of tezacaftor by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 50. Nevirapine reduces the levels or effects of tolvaptan by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 51. Nevirapine decreases the levels or effects of trabectedin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 52. Nevirapine reduces the levels or effects of trazodone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 53. Tucatinib increases nevirapine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 54. Nevirapine decreases the levels or effects of ulipristal by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 55. Nevirapine reduces the levels or effects of valbenazine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 56. Nevirapine decreases the levels or effects of venetoclax by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 57. Nevirapine reduces the levels or effects of vorapaxar by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 58. Abacavir and nevirapine both increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Use caution and monitor closely. 59. Nevirapine decreases the levels or effects of abiraterone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. 60. Nevirapine reduces the levels or effects of alfuzosin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 61. Nevirapine decreases the levels or effects of almotriptan by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 62. Nevirapine reduces the levels or effects of alprazolam by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 63. Nevirapine decreases the levels or effects of amiodarone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 64. Nevirapine reduces the levels or effects of amlodipine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 65. Amobarbital decreases nevirapine levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 66. Nevirapine reduces the levels or effects of aprepitant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 67. Nevirapine decreases the levels or effects of aripiprazole by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 68. Nevirapine reduces the levels or effects of armodafinil by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 69. Nevirapine decreases the levels or effects of artesunate by increasing its metabolism. Monitor for decreased efficacy. 70. Atazanavir and nevirapine both increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Use caution and monitor closely.
